integration_honesty_d056.detail: CI flowable job uses 'docker compose up -d postgres flowable' — fresh named volume per CI runner job; 002-flowable-schema.sql runs automatically via docker-entrypoint-initdb.d on first postgres init, creating the flowable schema before Flowable's Liquibase run. wait-ready.sh polls with 120s timeout (5s intervals) — adequate for the 5s observed startup time. No mocking, no stub services, no ambient state dependency. Pattern mirrors db job (D-056 rule: live fitness = fresh infra, not ambient).
